title: Message card · copy & send
description: Prescription-request step in voucher journeys. One per email.
usage: Pre-written message the user forwards to their doctor, in a bordered card. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.
notes: No JavaScript/clipboard in email: the copy hint is a plain text link (href="#") — point it at a landing page with the message, or leave it as a cue for the reader to select the text manually.
Copy hint is right-aligned bold caps with 0.96px letter-spacing, as in Figma.
Card border (#7B8290) is unchanged in dark mode; card fill flips to #464646 via mfs-dm-bg-grey.
[Name] is a placeholder — replace or personalise before send.
